panels.title: Last 50 tool calls
panels.description: Reads kind=tool_call Events as raw log lines over the selected window, newest first, limited to the last 50. A label_format stage sets session_label to the stream's own session_label, or the first 8 characters of session_id when it is absent, before Extract fields splits the raw labels field into one field per Event attribute, convertFieldType makes duration_ms numeric so it sorts and displays correctly, sortBy orders by Time descending, and limit keeps only the newest 50 rows. Columns: the call Time, Session label, tool name, Duration (ms), and whether it succeeded; no tool argument or tool result ever appears.

targets.expr: {service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="tool_call" | label_format session_label=`{{ if .session_label }}{{ .session_label }}{{ else }}{{ substr 0 8 .session_id }}{{ end }}`

panels.title: Time since last tool call
panels.description: Was a raw log selector with no metric function: a stat panel has no numeric field to reduce from a raw log line, so it always fell through to noValue even while the table above listed tool calls. Now a metric query: $__to (the built-in Grafana end-of-range variable, in Unix milliseconds) minus the latest observed_timestamp (converted from nanoseconds), grouped by session_id first so the aggregation never expands into Loki's per-stream series limit over a wide window (the same `by (session_id)` shape the Live: now and Live: trouble boards already prove correct), then the outer min() picks the smallest elapsed time, the single most recent tool call across every Session the pickers allow. The unit "s" auto-scales seconds into minutes once the value passes 60, giving a reading such as "35 s" or "4.25 min". noValue reads "no tool call yet" when the window holds no kind=tool_call Event at all.

targets.expr: min($__to - (max by (session_id) (max_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="tool_call" | unwrap observed_timestamp [$__range])) / 1000000)) / 1000

panels.title: Most used tool, last 5 minutes
panels.description: Reads kind=tool_call Events in a fixed trailing 5-minute window (independent of the dashboard's own selected range), the single tool with the highest call count, named by legendFormat and its count as the stat value. Printed the literal "Value #A" above the number instead of the tool name: STAT_OPTIONS sets reduceOptions.values to false, and a Loki instant query returns one frame per series, so values: false collapsed every named series down to a single unnamed value. A scratch Grafana dashboard against the same query confirmed the fix: setting values: true drew the series correctly named. Now this panel overrides reduceOptions with values: true on top of the shared STAT_OPTIONS, the one stat panel on this board that names a series rather than showing a single aggregate number.

targets.expr: topk(1, sum by (tool) (count_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="tool_call" [5m])))

panels.title: Active sessions in window
panels.description: Counts the distinct session_label values (falling back to the first 8 characters of session_id when absent) that emitted any Event anywhere in the selected window. Was a range query over $__interval steps reduced to its lastNotNull value, so it reported only the Sessions active in the final bucket of the window, not the window as a whole, which disagreed with the table above it. Now a single instant query over the whole $__range, counting the outer count() of a sum by (session_label) inner aggregation rather than a plain count by (session_label): a direct query against this exact dataset confirmed count by (session_label) alone raises "maximum of series (500) reached for a single query" over a wide window, where sum by (session_label) does not, the same sum-by substitution activeSessionsNowPanel on the Live: now board already uses for the same reason.

targets.expr: count(sum by (session_label) (count_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | label_format session_label=`{{ if .session_label }}{{ .session_label }}{{ else }}{{ substr 0 8 .session_id }}{{ end }}` [$__range])))

panels.title: Tool call counts by tool, top 20
panels.description: Shows the top 20 tools by kind=tool_call Event count over the selected window, as a horizontal bar chart so every tool name labels its own bar.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (tool) (count_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="tool_call" [$__range])))

panels.title: Tool calls per minute, mcp against native
panels.description: Stacks kind=tool_call Events in $__interval-stepped buckets over the selected window, one series per tool_type attribute, mcp against native. The bucket width is $__interval, not a fixed one-minute window: a fixed [1m] window is narrower than Grafana's own evaluation step over a wide range, so every sample point looks back only one minute while the points sit much further apart, and a capture whose Events cluster into a short burst falls in the gap between sample points and the panel reads "No data", confirmed directly against Loki with step=900 over 24 hours: the [1m] window returned no series, the [$__interval] window returned both the mcp and the native series.

targets.expr: sum by (tool_type) (count_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="tool_call" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Tool call duration, distribution in window
panels.description: Reads duration_ms on kind=tool_call Events, the median duration per Session over the whole selected window, one value per session_label, binned across every Session sampled. Loki cannot histogram a raw per-call value because duration_ms is unwrapped rather than a label, so this is the per-Session distribution, the same limitation the Latency board notes for its own model-call duration histogram.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="tool_call" | label_format session_label=`{{ if .session_label }}{{ .session_label }}{{ else }}{{ substr 0 8 .session_id }}{{ end }}` | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]) by (session_label)

panels.title: Result bytes by tool, top 20
panels.description: Sums result_bytes on kind=tool_call Events over the selected window, one named bar per tool, for the top 20 tools that report it, showing which tool floods the context. result_bytes is present only on a share of recorded Events, so a tool that never exposes it is absent from this panel rather than shown at zero.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (tool) (sum_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="tool_call" | result_bytes != "" | unwrap result_bytes [$__range])))

panels.title: Last 20 model calls
panels.description: Reads kind=model_call Events as raw log lines over the selected window, newest first, limited to the last 20. A label_format stage sets session_label to the stream's own session_label, or the first 8 characters of session_id when it is absent, before Extract fields splits the raw labels field into one field per Event attribute, convertFieldType makes duration_ms and output_tokens numeric, sortBy orders by Time descending, and limit keeps only the newest 20 rows. Columns: the call Time, Session label, model, Duration (ms), and output tokens; no prompt text ever appears.

targets.expr: {service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="model_call" | label_format session_label=`{{ if .session_label }}{{ .session_label }}{{ else }}{{ substr 0 8 .session_id }}{{ end }}`

panels.title: Turns over time
panels.description: Counts kind=prompt Events, one turn per prompt Event, in fixed one-minute buckets over the selected window.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="prompt" [1m]))

panels.title: Which tool each Session is running, top 20 pairs
panels.description: Shows one row per Session-and-tool pair, limited to the top 20 pairs by call count over the selected window (the same topk-per-step shape the Sessions board's "Session activity, by session" panel in explore-activity.ts uses for the same row-count fault), counting kind=tool_call Events in fixed one-minute buckets, so a Gantt-chart-like block appears while that Session is calling that tool and a gap appears otherwise. Unlimited, this panel drew 89 rows, one per distinct Session-and-tool pair, each labelled by a long concatenated string, a dense overlapping smear no operator could read. Each row is labelled by session_label (falling back to the first 8 characters of session_id when absent) and the tool name, and the panel is 24 grid rows tall, rather than the 8 rows most panels on this board use, so twenty rows stay legible.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (session_label, tool) (count_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="tool_call" | label_format session_label=`{{ if .session_label }}{{ .session_label }}{{ else }}{{ substr 0 8 .session_id }}{{ end }}` [1m])))

panels.title: Event kinds, over time
panels.description: Shows one row per Kind, counting every Event in fixed one-minute buckets over the selected window, including a record that reached no Kind. A label_format stage renames an empty kind to the literal "none" before grouping, so the rhythm of think (kind=prompt), act (kind=tool_call, kind=model_call), think is visible with every row legible.

targets.expr: sum by (kind) (count_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | label_format kind=`{{ if .kind }}{{ .kind }}{{ else }}none{{ end }}` [1m]))
